raw.support: actual Raw source valid_start/valid_samples, exact raw slice and pinned RawAlignmentStore parity, no positional identity, compound patient/run/sample/seizure mapping
raw.temporal_scope: full genuine source windows; not CoTAR[-10,20) crop
raw.invalid: masked unavailable, never treated as observed zeros

welch.band_edges: original low<=f<high on restricted available bins
welch.entropy: original PSD sum clip1e-8 and normalized log(number bins); do not replace with conventional unit-normalized entropy

delta.baseline: float32 mean of all genuine actual center<0 windows; at least1; no CoTAR[-10,0) substitution or all-window fallback
delta.within_record: original float32 mean of finite window-level DELTA across all genuine source windows
delta.across_records: masked mean and population std across genuinely present seizures, single-record std0; feature-major mean/std14

E14_parity.reference: named archive b0_delta columns and pinned original _p2_window_features/profile p2_matched_simple; no labels required
E14_parity.absolute_tolerance: 8*float32 ULP at absolute archived coordinate, smallest positive float32 atzero
E14_parity.discrepancy: compute original unmasked historical support only as label-blind diagnosis; if genuine-support E14 differs, do not choose historical contaminated support to pass. Explicitly investigate then stop if unresolved.

fidelity.scope: unique union of original FIT identities (actual79), no labels; per-fold original FIT summaries also reported, all80 retained for alignment/coverage
fidelity.estimable: >=3 finite channels; both compared coordinates have more than1 distinct value and positive finite population SD; no source-dependent quality filtering
fidelity.primary_family_gate: min(median FIT-patient Spearman for seizure_mean, median for seizure_std)>=0.80; conservative both-statistic family definition locked before measurements
fidelity.normalized_MAE_denominator: median absolute engineered coordinate, diagnostic floor1e-30 only; not predictive scaling

stage_A_gate: finite Raw-derived inputs under historical preprocessing
>=4/5 AB families pass fixed correlation threshold

stage_B.LayerNorm: exact duplicate/zero-aware original88-position semantics, no nativeLN14
stage_B.preprocess: original SimpleImputer/StandardScaler fitted independently on original FIT for E1/R14, never VAL orTEST
stage_B.initialization: same foldseed scratch original source-free88D initializer folded for E1/D1, no trained E1 warmstart
stage_B.objective: original NEZ-positive FIT class weighted BCE, one channel-mean update per FITpatient
stage_B.selection: validation patient MacroF1, EZF1, earlier epoch; originalNEZ0.005 grid/ties

secondary_five_family: fixed A/B numerical fidelity comparisons; no additional competitive model or subset search

stage_C.base: same frozen successfulD1 checkpoint per fold, never engineered values
stage_C.CNN: Conv1d1to12 k9 stride4 GELU Conv1d12to24 k7 stride4 GELU AdaptiveAvgPool1d1
stage_C.latent_baseline: mean genuine center<0 embeddings per seizure/channel
stage_C.GRU: forward1layer input25 (24latentDELTA+actual time/20), hidden24; no attention; process genuine [0,20) windows chronologically
stage_C.summary: stage mean hidden24 for[0,8),[8,20), masked across-seizure mean/populationstd ->96; original-style patientZ populationSD<=1e-8 denominator1 across valid canonical channels
stage_C.head: Linear96to64 GELU Linear64to1
stage_C.training: AdamW0.0003 wd0.001 clip1 max30 min6 patience6, one update/FITpatient original classweights and VAL selection
stage_C.shuffle: hash seed42|patient|run|sample|canonical channel|stage ->rng permutation; deterministically avoid identity if>=2; move complete post-window content/latent vectors among fixed chronological positions insideeachstage, retain original destination time coordinate; pre/reference/masks unchanged
stage_C.CNN_input_normalization: exact historicalRawTiny per-window mean/populationSD floor1e-6, clip[-8,8], no population fitting; physiologicalR14 is always measured on unnormalized originalRaw samples

publish: code hashes anonymous aggregate statistics only; raw, IDs, labels, weights, predictions, logs remain private
